# User CLI Preferences

<!-- Generated by go run ./tools/configreference -write-doc. Do not edit by hand. -->

[Back to Daemon Config Reference](../config-reference.md)

User-mode local/staging/production preferences live in the OS UserConfigDir/riido-cli/config.json, version 1. Only profile, api_origin, workspace, team, format and timeout are accepted; tokens, cookies and credentials are never stored or displayed. Missing files use defaults; malformed or unknown versions fail without reset. Writes lock and atomically replace the file, compare the selected profile snapshot, and preserve other profiles. CLI flags override the allowed environment, profile settings, then defaults. Agent calls and help never read this file.

| Variable | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RIIDO_CLI_PROFILE | User profile selector; --profile wins | Active profile, otherwise production |
| RIIDO_CLI_API_URL | Validated OAuth/API origin for the selected profile; separate from daemon device-link configuration | Profile api_origin, otherwise production=https://monolith.riido.io or staging=https://monolith.api.riido.io; local requires explicit literal loopback origin |
| RIIDO_CLI_WORKSPACE | Default for commands accepting workspace scope | Origin-matched profile workspace, otherwise empty |
| RIIDO_CLI_TEAM | Default for commands supporting --team-id; --team is an alias | Origin-matched profile team, otherwise empty |
| RIIDO_CLI_FORMAT | json or text output default | Profile format, otherwise text |
| RIIDO_CLI_TIMEOUT | Positive duration, maximum 10m | Profile timeout, otherwise reads 30s and interactive auth 5m |

Resolve once per invocation: origin determines the existing origin-keyed protected credential store and all HTTP calls. Same-origin profiles share the same credentials, not separate accounts. Stored workspace/team apply only to their selection origin; an origin change clears selections and a workspace change clears its old team. workspace use (also config set workspace) verifies current membership across typed pages under one protected login session and saves only after final session checks. These preferences are not permissions: every later API request rechecks server authority. config list/get expose effective profile/environment values with their source; presentation flags affect rendering, not the stored values. Completion and display-key resolution remain separate.
